settingText: MIXED COMMERCIAL INCIDENT SITE — ordinary maintained retail/service space after a small opportunistic exploit attack on an Augment worker. Keep the scene civic and human-scale; the attacker is already gone and the vulnerability is the point.

PUBLIC COMMERCIAL PASSAGE — active mixed-use corridor where an aerosol exploit harms an Organic courier. Preserve ordinary storefronts, ventilation infrastructure and bystanders so the attack reads as an intrusion into daily life, not a battle zone.

PUBLIC COMMERCIAL PASSAGE — same corridor and aftermath as Page 3 after ventilation is sealed and the Organic courier is being stabilized. Preserve the shopfronts, bystander positions and ventilation geography from the preceding page.

AUGMENT CIVIC ASSEMBLY — ordinary meeting space used by economically mixed Augments debating regulation after the vulnerability attacks. Clothing, hardware quality and social position should vary; this is not a faction-uniform rally.

ORGANIC LOCAL ROUTING TEST — ordinary Organic district streets, service passages and transit connections used by the decentralized routing layer. Local nodes should look like resident-controlled civic infrastructure, not rebel tech.

STACK-WIDE DISTRIBUTED ATTACK RESPONSE — simultaneous small exploit incidents in separate districts: suppressant exposure, firmware lock, sensory overload and false maintenance instructions. Keep the protagonists in different locations rather than assembling a superhero team.

STACK-WIDE PUBLIC REACTION — mass demonstrations and ordinary civic life continue at once, with Organic, Augment and Baseline constituencies visibly disagreeing within their own groups. The government review announcement remains institutional rather than militarized.
